activeSkill.name: Frozen Maelstorm
activeSkill.description: After a brief charge-up, unleash a Frozen Maelstrom forward, dealing [Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage to enemies in the area, applying Slow by 40%% and reducing Attack Speed by 40%%, lasting 6s. The punch also deals [Damage Rate: 300%] additional Magic Damage to enemies directly in front and applies Frozen for 3s.

passiveSkill.name: Fractured Ice
passiveSkill.description:
Gains 25% Damage Resistance if damage is dealt within 5, lasts for 6s. When taking damage during this time, sends forth freezing air in all directions, dealing [Damage Rate: 80%] Magic Damage to targets within range, reducing Attack Speed by 30% and Movement Speed by 30% for 4s. Minimum interval of 1s.
(Cooldown: 20s)

activeSkill.name: Magma Slam
activeSkill.description: Leaps to the target location. Gains immunity to control during leap. Deals [Damage Rate: 350%] Physical Damage and knocks enemies in the area up for 1.5s.

passiveSkill.name: Seismic Impact
passiveSkill.description:
When inflicting Immobilize or Hard Control (Stun, Fear, Freeze, Knockup, Petrify), drops a meteor after 1s, dealing [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage and 30% Slow for 3s.
(Cooldown: 5s)

activeSkill.name: Sandstorm Dominion
activeSkill.description: Creates a Sandstorm around the caster, pushing all enemies outside. Channels for 6s with +45% Damage Resistance and control immunity. Enemies touching the field take [Damage Rate: 300%] Physical Damage, Slowed by 60% for 4s and dispelled from all buffs. Also knocks them back 11m from center. The Sandstorm applies 60% Slow.

passiveSkill.name: Sand Veil
passiveSkill.description:
Creates a circular storm field around the caster for 4s when causing Forced Movement (Pull, Knockback). Deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical Damage to enemies in field, inflicting Silence and a 40% chance to miss Basic Attacks for 3s.
(Cooldown: 20s)

activeSkill.name: Protector's Radiance
activeSkill.description: Channel for 6s, gaining immunity to control. Allies on the field gain +40% Max HP and immunity to Forced Movement (Pull, Knockback). Each 5000 total damage taken by allies grants 1 Energy stack, up to 5. Use again within 12s of starting the channeling to unleash absorbed energy, dealing [Damage Rate: 350%] - [Damage Rate: 700%] Magic Damage based on stacks and reducing Movement Speed by 30% for 4s.

passiveSkill.name: Reflective Shield
passiveSkill.description:
Taking damage equal to 10% of Max HP within 5s after skill cast grants 25% Damage Resistance for 6s. During this time, reflect Magic Damage equal to 65% + 1.5% of Max HP to the attacker.
(Cooldown: 25s)

activeSkill.name: Shackled Grip
activeSkill.description: Channel for 4s with control immunity and 30% increased Movement Speed. On hit, deals [Damage Rate: 215%] Physical Damage and creates a chain link (max 5 chains). Chains break at range limit. After the channeling ends, pull all chained targets to deal [Damage Rate: 215%] Physical Damage and Stun them for 1.5s.

passiveSkill.name: Imprisonment
passiveSkill.description:
When inflicting Forced Movement (Pull, Knockback) on enemies, creates a circular prison lasting 4s. Enemies touching the prison take [Damage Rate: 100%] Magic Damage and are Immobilized until the prison ends.
(Cooldown: 20s)

activeSkill.name: Cannonade
activeSkill.description: Transform into a turret for 25s. Basic Attacks become artillery strikes, firing projectiles at targets beyond 8m, dealing [Damage Rate: 250%] Physical Damage. Artillery Critical Damage is 150%.  While in turret form gain increased Magic Resistance.

passiveSkill.name: Resolve
passiveSkill.description:
While standing still, gain 1 stack of [Steadfast] every second.

[Steadfast]: +2% Critical Rate, +1.5% damage for 3s. Stacks up to 15 times

activeSkill.name: Shield of Conviction
activeSkill.description: Grants Shield of Conviction to up to 5 allies around the caster for 6s. Allies with Shield of Conviction gain [Target-based Max HP 30%] Shield effect, and 30% of damage dealt will be converted into shield value, up to [Target-based Max HP 15%] additional Shield. After 6s, if the shield remains unbroken, deals [Damage Rate: 300%] Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Subsequent explosions deal reduced damage (15%).

passiveSkill.name: Defiant Resolve
passiveSkill.description:
Gains immunity to control effects and 20% Damage Resistance whenever gaining shield for as long as the shield remains.
(Cooldown: 20s)

activeSkill.name: Skyward Leap
activeSkill.description: Creates a protection zone at the target location that grants allies within +30% Damage Resistance, +40% Healing Received, +40% Dodge and heals for  [Healing Rate: 50%] HP every second. Then leaps to the target location, dealing [Damage Rate: 250%] Physical Damage to those hit and knocking them up for 1s. Immune to control during prep and leap.

passiveSkill.name: Healing Guardian
passiveSkill.description:
Gains 25% Damage Resistance for 1s if HP is below 75%. Sends healing radiation waves in all directions, healing allies in range for [Healing Rate: 50%] HP and granting [Target-based Max HP 5%] Shield every 1s for 4s.
(Cooldown: 20s)

activeSkill.name: Acid Blast
activeSkill.description:
Sprays ooze for 4s, creating 4 ooze zones every second that last 8.5s. Enemies in ooze zones are Slowed by 50%. Enemies entering ooze zones gain [Acid Blast].

[Acid Blast] Reduces Damage by 40% and cancels Stealth. Takes [Damage Rate: 20%] Magic Damage every 1s per stack for 6s. Stacks up to 3 times.

passiveSkill.name: Corrosion Barrier
passiveSkill.description: After taking 5 instances of damage, releases acid outward, dealing [Damage Rate: 70%] Magic Damage to enemies in range, reducing their damage dealt by 25% and Movement Speed by 25% for 4s.

activeSkill.name: Flamecore Rampage
activeSkill.description:
Removes all current shield values, dealing  [Damage Rate: 250%] Physical Damage to nearby enemies, while also gaining 55% Attack Speed, 30% Movement Speed, and 30% Critical Rate, and becoming Immune to Control Effects for 6s.

Can't be dispelled.

passiveSkill.name: Hell Salvo's Embrace
passiveSkill.description:
While without Armor, gains 5 Energy per second, and gains 5 Energy on Basic Attack Crit. When Energy reaches 100, restores [Target-based Max HP 15%] Armor.

While with Armor, gains [Target-based Max HP 3%] Armor on Basic Attack Crit. Armor restored cannot exceed [Target-based Max HP 25%].
(Trigger Interval: 1s)

activeSkill.name: Tempest Slash
activeSkill.description:
Launches a flurry of slashes at the target and nearby enemies, each dealing [Damage Rate: 120%] Physical Damage. Damage reduces by 50% after the first hit on the same target. Flurry for 4s with Immune to control effects and Damage Immunity.

Damage is affected by Basic Attack Damage Boost and can Critical Hit based on Basic Attack Crit Rate.

Higher Attack Speed increases the number of slashes.
(Cooldown: 30s)

passiveSkill.name: Cyclone Reap
passiveSkill.description:
On Critical Hit, deals [Damage Rate: 70%] Physical Damage to nearby enemies, while also reducing their Armor by 15% for 4s.
(Cooldown: 1.3s)

activeSkill.name: Spectral Disquise
activeSkill.description:
Creates a Spectral Disguise granting Stealth to the caster and up to 15 nearby allies, increasing Damage Resistance by 25% for 8s.

Using a skill, dealing damage or inflicting healing breaks Stealth for 4s before reapplying.

passiveSkill.name: Echo Reflection
passiveSkill.description:
Skill and Basic Attack hits from the rear deal  [Damage Rate: 60%] additional Physical Damage (Cooldown: 0.3s).

Basic Attack Damage Bonuses affect damage and basic attack critical hits can cause the damage to crit.

activeSkill.name: Storm Pulse
activeSkill.description: Activate an Electric Device for 8s. Electric Device hits up to 5 enemies every 0.5s for [Damage Rate: 40%] Physical Damage, reducing Armor by 8% for 8s. Stacks up to 10 times.

passiveSkill.name: Static Overdrive
passiveSkill.description: Basic Attacks grant 1 stack of Electric Charge. At 5 stacks, the next attack triggers EMP Blast dealing [Damage Rate: 160%] Physical Damage to enemies in range.

activeSkill.name: Null Pulse
activeSkill.description: Releases a Null Pulse in the target direction, dealing [Damage Rate: 50%] Physical Damage to enemies in range, knocking them back 12m, and applying Silence and 40% Slow for 3s.

passiveSkill.name: Overclocking Reflex
passiveSkill.description: Has a 35% chance to dodge Basic Attack damage.

activeSkill.name: Soul Feast
activeSkill.description:
Creates a void field lasting 8s that envelops the caster and up to 5 enemies, dealing 192[Damage Rate: 50%] Magic Damage to enemies within. Enemies in the void are immune to Physical Damage, cannot perform basic attacks, are slowed for 30%, and have their Magic Resistance reduced by 30%.

The caster can still perform basic attacks and gain 35% Basic Attack Lifesteal, while also ignoring the Physical Damage immunity of enemies in the void.

passiveSkill.name: Void Construct
passiveSkill.description: Converts Physical Damage from Basic Attacks into Magic Damage. Each time an attack deals damage, it reduces the target's Magic Resistance by 4%, for 4s, stacking up to 10.

activeSkill.name: Shadow Dive
activeSkill.description:
Enters Stealth, gaining [Spectral Shield] and the ability [Phantom Bind], lasting 9s.

[Spectral Shield]:
Grants [Target-based Max HP 25%] shield effect; if the Spectral Shield fades out, the Phantom Bind effect ends prematurely.

[Phantom Bind]:
Summon phantoms that track enemies in range, dealing [Damage Rate: 183%] Magic Damage and replenishing [Target-based Max HP 5%] Spectral Shield. Doesn't break Phantom Clone Stealth.

Using any skill other than Phantom Bind, or dealing direct healing or damage, reveals you for 2s before re-entering Stealth.

Recovers 6% HP every 2s while in Stealth.

passiveSkill.name: Healing Bloom Hunter
passiveSkill.description:
Enters Stealth when standing still unhurt and not using skills for a short duration. Damage, skills, or movement breaks Stealth.

Warning when enemies are 7-14m away.

Stealth breaks after 3s within 7m.

Recovers 6% HP every 2s while in Stealth

activeSkill.name: Hemophage
activeSkill.description: Activates Crimson Vortex for 6s. Crimson Vortex deals [Damage Rate: 75%] Magical Damage to up to 5 enemies every second, healing the caster for 60% of damage dealt against players, 30% versus monsters. Damage increases up to [Damage Rate: 150%] as HP drops.

passiveSkill.name: Blood Contract
passiveSkill.description: Gains +4% Damage Resistance and +6% Attack Speed for every 10% HP lost.

activeSkill.name: Shadow Rift
activeSkill.description:
Creates a field around the caster, lasting 20s. Then scatter 8 Shadow Clones, each dealing [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical Damage to those hit. Damage reduces to 15% for subsequent hits on the same target. While in the field, skill changes to [Shadow Swap]. Touching a Shadow Clone reduces Shadow Swap's cooldown by 5s, grants [Target-based Max HP 10%] Shield and +20% Movement Speed for 4s. Field disappears when leaving range.

[Shadow Swap]:
Dash forward and increase the Attack Speed of the next 5 basic attacks within 6s by 60%.

passiveSkill.name: Umbra Kinetics
passiveSkill.description:
Grants Basic Attacks a 30% chance to trigger a shadow strike for 6s, dealing [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical Damage
(Cooldown: 0.8s).

Basic Attack Damage Bonuses affect damage and basic attack critical hits can cause the damage to crit.

activeSkill.name: Twinlance Infusion
activeSkill.description:
Creates a Lunar Domain and channels for 8s. Enemies within are struck by starlight on skill use, taking [Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage and losing 20 MP. Allies within recover 8 MP every second and gain  [Target-based Max HP 15%] Shield lasting 4s.

Skill cannot be interrupted.

+20% Movement Speed while channeling.

passiveSkill.name: Lunar Rebirth
passiveSkill.description: Every 2s restores Moonveil Max MP + 3% MP to other allies within 12m

activeSkill.name: Shadow Cascade
activeSkill.description:
Channel void energy for 5s and send forth 37 Void Orbs, each dealing [Damage Rate: 35%] Magic Damage and inflicting [Void Toxin].

Skill cannot be interrupted.

[Void Toxin]:
Deals [Damage Rate: 10%] Magic Damage every second (increases based on stacks) for 12s, stacking up to 5 times. [Void Toxin] from different sources share stacks.

passiveSkill.name: Umbra Resonance
passiveSkill.description: Gains 5% Movement Speed for 3s when inflicting an enemy with a DoT effect, stacking up to 6 times.

activeSkill.name: Abyssal Sovereignty
activeSkill.description:
Removes all control effects and gains [Submerge] for 2.5s

[Submerge]:
Dives underground, becoming immune to all damage and control effects. Increases Movement Speed by 40% and recovers[Healing Rate: 49%] HP every second. Press skill again to exit [Submerge] early. Upon exiting [Submerge], deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

Can be used while skills are disabled.

passiveSkill.name: Hive Exaltation
passiveSkill.description:
Dealing damage with a skill grants 1 stack of Swarm, restoring [Healing Rate: 7.5%] HP every 2s for 6s (stacks do not boost healing effect). During this time, Damage Resistance increases by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.
(Cooldown: 0.5s)

activeSkill.name: Raven's Gaze
activeSkill.description:
Select an enemy target to summon ravens. After 2 seconds, ravens dive to attack, dealing [Damage Rate: 210%] Magic Damage to up to 10 enemies in range, dispelling all buffs, shields, and HoT effects. Applies 50% Slow and reduces damage dealt by 50% for 6s.

Targets cannot gain buffs, shields, or HoT effects during this time.

passiveSkill.name: Summon Raven
passiveSkill.description:
Skills dealing damage grant the caster Raven's Call. At 6 stacks, the next skill damage within 8s that hits an enemy target will summon ravens at the location, dealing [Damage Rate: 120%] Magic Damage to up to 5 enemy targets in range. This effect removes 1 stack of buffs from hit targets and restores [Healing Rate: 60%] HP to self.
(Trigger Interval: 0.5s)

activeSkill.name: Genetic Cascade
activeSkill.description:
Creates a Genetic Cascade link with the target, lasting 15s.

For allied targets: Restores [Healing Rate: 25%] HP every second and increases damage dealt by 3% for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.

For enemy targets: Deals [Damage Rate: 50%] Magic Damage every second and reduces damage dealt by 3% for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.

Can link to another target of a different type while a link is active.

Link breaks if the target moves over 25m away.

passiveSkill.name: Helical Convergence
passiveSkill.description:
After dealing damage 5 times, creates two Yin Vortexes around the caster that deal [Damage Rate: 100%] Magic Damage to enemies hit and reduce healing received by 5% for 4s. Stacks up to 3 times.
(Cooldown: 0.5s)

After healing 5 times, creates two Yang Vortexes around self that restore [Healing Rate: 50%] HP to allies hit and increase healing received by 5% for 4s. Stacks up to 3 times.
(Cooldown: 0.5s)

activeSkill.name: Serpent's Whisper
activeSkill.description:
Applies Serpent's Whisper to the caster or an allied target, preventing movement and skill usage for 4s and granting immunity to damage and control. Deals [Damage Rate: 58%] Magic Damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s and applies [Creeping Stone].

[Creeping Stone]:
Lasts 1s, stacking up to 4 times. Target is Petrified and has their Armor reduced by 25% for 2 at max stacks (cannot gain [Creeping Stone] for 6).

Can be used while skills are disabled.

Serpent's Whisper cannot be dispelled.

passiveSkill.name: Shedskin
passiveSkill.description:
Retains 1 HP upon taking lethal damage, transforming into a spirit serpent, cleansing all negative effects (control, DoT, and debuffs), gaining immunity to control, debuffs and damage for 2s, and +100% Movement Speed, and healing 5% HP every 0.5s.
(Cooldown: 120s)

activeSkill.name: Bond of Light
activeSkill.description:
Links to 8 targets within 10m around the caster, channeling for 4s. Restores [Healing Rate: 40%] HP to the caster and linked allies every 0.5s, while dealing  [Damage Rate: 70%] Magic Damage to linked enemies.

Cannot be interrupted while channeling.

passiveSkill.name: Light's Echo
passiveSkill.description: Other allies within 12m receive +20% healing.

activeSkill.name: Sanctification
activeSkill.description:
Creates an expanding Sanctification Field at the target location and channels for 5s. Cleanses control effects every 0.5s, all debuffs, and 2 DoT effects, from up to 20 allies in the field and restores [Healing Rate: 25%] HP.

Cannot be interrupted while channeling.

passiveSkill.name: Holy Covenant
passiveSkill.description: When healing with skills, the target gains 5% additional Damage Resistance for 4s. Stacks up to 6 times

activeSkill.name: Astral Gate
activeSkill.description:
Creates an astral field beneath the caster. After 3s, teleports up to 15 teammates in range to the target location. Upon arrival, deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage to surrounding enemies and Stuns them for 1s. Allies gain [Target-based Max HP 20%] Shield, +30% Movement Speed effects for 4s. If there's unpassable terrain in the teleportation path, teleport to that position instead.

Target cannot be teleported by Astral Gate for 10 seconds after teleportation.

passiveSkill.name: Celestial Rotation
passiveSkill.description:
Reduces the cooldown of all skills (not including Tactical Item skills) by 0.3s when this skill deals damage.
(Cooldown: 0.5s)

activeSkill.name: Mole's Escape
activeSkill.description: Throws a robot in the target direction, dealing [Damage Rate: 110%] Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and binding them in place. Bound enemies are pulled to the center when attempting to leave.

passiveSkill.name: Survivability Resilience
passiveSkill.description: Increases carrying weight limit.

core_skill.name: Bloom of Malice
core_skill.description:
Plants a Bloom of Malice seed before channeling energy to it for 3s.

The seed grows gradually until blooming (press skill again to bloom early). When blooming, deals [Damage Rate: 360%] Magic Damage to nearby enemies, inflicts [Plague] based on growth time, and reduces Max HP by 2.5% for 12s (stacks up to 10 times).

Effects increase with growth time ([Plague] stacks 1-2-> 3-10 / Max HP stacks 1 ->10)

core_skill.name: Necrotic Eruption
core_skill.description: Throws a device that generates Necromists randomly within range every 3s (range gradually expands). Device lasts 10s. Necromists deal [Damage Rate: 60%] Magic Damage every 2s, inflict [Plague], and reduce healing received by 5% for 12s, stacking up to 5 times.

core_skill.name: Sanctuary
core_skill.description: Cleanses an ally or the caster of all Slow and Immobilize effects, heals [Healing Rate: 300%] HP and grants Sanctuary for 5s. Sanctuary grants immunity to Slow and Immobilize, and prevents HP from falling below 1. Each 10% of missing HP increases healing received by 5%. Sanctuary cannot be dispelled.

core_skill.name: Blessed Halo
core_skill.description: Creates a Blessed Halo at the target location. After 1s, heals all allies in range for [Healing Rate: 300%] HP, cleanses all control effects and 5 debuffs, and grants immunity to Control and Slow for 4s.

core_skill.name: Frost's Caller
core_skill.description:
Grants the power of arctic frost for 20s. Becomes immune to Slows and Immobilize effects, and gains access to the [Frost Slash] and [Frost Drift] skills.

[Frost Slash]:
Launches ice blades forward that deal [Damage Rate: 110%] Magic Damage to enemies in their path, inflicting 1 stack of [Hypothermia] and reducing Movement Speed by 30% for 4s. At 6 stacks of [Hypothermia], the target gains [Deep Frost].

[Deep Frost]:
Cannot attack or move for 1.5s.

[Frost Drift]:
Instantly removes control effects and leaps in the target direction.

core_skill.name: Ice Blast
core_skill.description: Creates a frost crystal at the target location that forms after 0.7s, dealing [Damage Rate: 75%] Magic Damage and Freezing enemies for 1.5s. After 1s, the crystal shatters, dealing [Damage Rate: 400%] Magic Damage, and reducing Movement Speed by 40% and Attack Speed by 40% for 6s

core_skill.name: Molten Volley
core_skill.description: Enter Molten Volley Mode for 20s. Cannot move while active but can cancel manually. Basic Attack replaced: Fires magma at the target location that rolls forward after impact, dealing  [Damage Rate: 90%] Magic Damage to those hit and inflicting 1 stack of [Burn]. Damage increases by 10% after each enemy hit, up to 40%.

core_skill.name: Starforge Beam
core_skill.description:
Channels a starforge beam for 4s after a 1s cast. Deals [Damage Rate: 85%] Magic Damage to enemies in range every 0.5s, inflicting 1 stack of [Burn] and [Scorch]. Each hit increases damage by 10%, up to 50%. Cannot be interrupted during channeling and grants a [Target-based Max HP 25%] shield.

[Scorch]:
Reduces healing received by 5% for 4s. Stacks up to 3 times.

core_skill.name: Crippling Curse
core_skill.description:
Channels for 0.5s to curse a circular area. After a brief delay, deals [Damage Rate: 250%] Magic Damage to up to 10 enemies in range, dispeling all Buffs, shields, and HoT effects, and inflicting [Crippled] for 6s.

[Crippled]:
Cannot use movement skills or gain buffs, shields, or HoT effects Movement Speed Bonus: -50%

core_skill.name: Parasitic Swarm
core_skill.description:
Infects an enemy with [Parasites].

[Parasites]:
Parasites last 12s and deal [Damage Rate: 50%] True Damage whenever the target takes direct damage (minimum interval 0.8s). When dispelled, deals [Damage Rate: 350%] Magic Damage

core_skill.name: Pestilence
core_skill.description: Infects any target with Pestilence Source for 8s. Every second, deals [Damage Rate: 65%] Magic Damage to the infected and nearby enemies. Inflicts 1 stack of [Plague] and reduces damage dealt by 5% to enemies except the carrier for 4s, stacking up to 5 times.

core_skill.name: Hexbound Malice
core_skill.description:
Channels for 0.5s to inflict 2 stacks of [Plague] as well as [Hexbound Malice] to enemies in range, lasting 9s.

[Hexbound Malice]:
Each active skill used consumes 10 extra MP and inflicts [Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage.

core_skill.name: Sacred Flare
core_skill.description: Casts holy radiance at the target location. Heals allies in range for [Healing Rate: 100%] HP and deals  [Damage Rate: 300%] Magic Damage to enemies, knocking them back 7m from the center. Gives enemies 60% chance to miss Basic Attacks and reveals Stealth for 6s.

core_skill.name: Sanctified Domain
core_skill.description:
Creates a holy domain that deals [Damage Rate: 300%] Magic Damage to enemies in range and knocks them back 10m.

Channels for 3s, healing allies in range for  [Healing Rate: 50%] HP every 0.5s and increasing their Damage Resistance by 10% for 6s. Stacks up to 3 times.

core_skill.name: Sanctum Arc
core_skill.description: Launches a Holy Chain that bounces to the nearest allied target within 9 meters after hitting an ally, restoring [Healing Rate: 100%] HP with each hit. It deals  [Damage Rate: 100%] Magic Damage to up to 5 enemy targets in range, with damage reduced to 20% for subsequent explosions. The chain can bounce up to 9 times, and each target can be hit a maximum of 3 times.

core_skill.name: Divine Vault
core_skill.description: Leaps to the target location. Upon landing, deals [Damage Rate: 300%] Magic Damage to enemies in range and knocks them up for 0.75s. Heals allies in range for [Healing Rate: 150%] HP and increases their Dodge by 30% for 6s.

core_skill.name: Frozen Phase
core_skill.description: Launches a frost orb in the target direction that deals [Damage Rate: 70%] Magic Damage every second and reduces Movement Speed by 40% for 3s to enemies in range. Within 3s, can recast to blink to the orb's location, dealing [Damage Rate: 250%] Magic Damage and Freezing nearby enemies for 1.5s.

core_skill.name: Frost Nova
core_skill.description: Places a Frost Nova at the target location, lasting 15s. When triggered by an enemy, deals [Damage Rate: 250%] Magic Damage and reduces Movement Speed by 35% and 15% reduced healing for 6s. Gains 1 charge every 15s, up to 3 charges

core_skill.name: Frostbound Echo
core_skill.description: Launches ice in the target direction. Upon hitting an enemy, it splits into 3 ice shards that bounce between nearby enemies up to 5 times. Each target can be hit up to 3 times. Each hit deals [Damage Rate: 70%] Magic Damage and reduces Attack Speed by 15% for 4s. Stacks up to 3 times.

core_skill.name: Frostbite
core_skill.description: Creates a freezing cyclone at the target location, lasting 5s. Enemies inside are Slowed by 60% and take  [Damage Rate: 90%] Magic Damage every second.

core_skill.name: Hell Salvo
core_skill.description: After a 1s cast, channels for 3s, continuously firing at target. Each projectile deals [Damage Rate: 45%] Magic Damage to enemies hit, inflicts 1 stack of [Burn], and reduces Magic Resistance by 8% for 4s. Stacks up to 6 times.

core_skill.name: Core Flare
core_skill.description:
Launches 3 Core Flare orbs at the target location. Each nova deals [Damage Rate: 180%] Magic Damage to enemies hit and inflicts 1 stack of [Burn] and 1 stack of [Scorch]. Additional novas hitting the same target deal 30% reduced damage. Gains 1 charge every 15s, up to 3 charges.

[Scorch]:
Reduces healing received by 5% for 4s. Stacks up to 3 times

core_skill.name: Scorching Surge
core_skill.description: After a 1s cast, launches three scorching surges at the target location. After 1s, the flames erupt, each dealing Damage Rate: 240%] Magic Damage and inflicting 1 stack of [Burn] and Knockup for 1s to enemies in range. Damage reduces to 50% for enemies that take damage from more than one scorching surge.

core_skill.name: Molten Blast
core_skill.description:
Fires a Molten Blast in target direction that explodes on impact, dealing [Damage Rate: 150%] Magic Damage to enemies in range and inflicting 1 stack of [Burn].

Can be charged. At 3s charge time, the Molten Blast can penetrate enemies along its path, dealing [Damage Rate: 50%] Magic Damage and exploding at the end point to deal [Damage Rate: 250%] Magic Damage, inflicting 2 stacks of [Burn], and applying Knockback to enemies within the explosion range by 3m. Gains 1 charge every 18s, up to 2 charges.

core_skill.name: Rot Manifest
core_skill.description: After a 1s cast, doubles the stacks of [Plague] on an enemy target and refreshes the duration to maximum. If the doubled stacks exceed the limit, deals ([Damage Rate: 55%] per stack) Magic Damage for excess stacks. If the target does not have [Plague], inflicts at least one stack of [Plague] and deals [Damage Rate: 55%] Magic Damage.

core_skill.name: Aegisflare
core_skill.description: Grants a shield of [Target-based Max HP 25%] to the caster or an ally for 4s. When the shield breaks, deals [Damage Rate: 250%] Magic Damage to nearby enemies

core_skill.name: Frost Torrent
core_skill.description:
Channels for 3s, releasing frost winds in the target direction that deal [Damage Rate: 100%] Magic Damage to players ([Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage to mobs) every 0.5s and reduce Movement Speed by 30% for 3s.

Can move slowly while channeling

core_skill.name: Hellfire
core_skill.description: After 1s cast, launches scorching flames at the target location to create Hellfire. Hellfire lasts 6s, dealing [Damage Rate: 70%] Magic Damage to all players ([Damage Rate: 140%] Magic Damage to mobs) within and inflicting 1 stack of [Burn] every 1s

core_skill.name: Hellfire
core_skill.description: After 1s cast, launches scorching flames at the target location to create Hellfire. Hellfire lasts 6s, dealing [Damage Rate: 70%] Magic Damage to all players ([Damage Rate: 140%] Magic Damage to mobs) within and inflicting 1 stack of [Burn] every 1s

core_skill.name: Photon Activation
core_skill.description:
Activates Photon Activation for 20s. Immune to Slow and Immobilize. Gains [Prism Beam] and [Prism Camo].

[Prism Beam]:
Consume 1 bullet and deals [Damage Rate: 120%] Physical Damage and drains 5 MP from enemies before the shooter. Gains +25% Movement Speed for 3s. common_skills.description: Deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Magic Damage to enemies in range and creates a Field of Silence, lasting 4s. Enemies in the field are Slowed by 25% and Silenced. Once they leave the area, they become immune to the field's Silence for 6s.

common_skills.name: Vengeful Thunder
common_skills.description:
Applies [Vengeful Thunder] to the caster or an allied target.

[Vengeful Thunder]:
Increases Damage Resistance by 25% for 8s. When taking damage or dealing Basic Attack Damage, calls down lightning at the target location, dealing [Damage Rate: 51%] Physical Damage.
(Cooldown: 0.8s)

passive_skill.name: Guardian
passive_skill.description: Using a weapon skill increases Damage Resistance by 30% and Control Resistance by 35 for 6s.

basic_attacks.name: Evil Seed
basic_attacks.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 80%] Magic Damage. Throws an [Evil Seed] after 5 Basic Attacks.

[Evil Seed]:
Throws an Evil Seed at the target location, creating a thorn zone that lasts 5s. The zone deals [Damage Rate: 40%] Magic Damage every second to up to 5 enemies and reduces their Movement Speed by 25%.

basic_attacks.name: Soothing Mist
basic_attacks.description:
Releases Soothing Mist in the target direction, dealing [Damage Rate: 70%] Magic Damage to enemies hit, while applying 1 stack of [Recovery] to allies.

[Recovery]:
Restores HP every second for 12s, stacking up to 3 times.
HP recovery at 1 | 2 | 3 stacks: [Healing Rate: 10%] | [Healing Rate: 15%] | [Healing Rate: 20%]

basic_attacks.name: Healing Seed
basic_attacks.description:
Throws a healing seed at the target location that blooms, healing nearby allies for [Healing Rate: 55%] HP and applying 1 stack of [Recovery] to allies.

[Recovery]:
Restores HP every second for 12s, stacking up to 3 times.
HP recovery at 1 | 2 | 3 stacks: [Healing Rate: 10%] | [Healing Rate: 15%] | [Healing Rate: 20%]

common_skills.name: Winding Vines
common_skills.description: After a brief delay, creates an entangling zone lasting 4s. Deals [Damage Rate: 90%] Magic Damage every second and immobilizes enemies that enter for 1.5s.

common_skills.name: Energize
common_skills.description: Creates an energizing aura around the caster, lasting 5s. Restores [Healing Rate: 39%] HP and 12 MP every second to up to 10 nearby allies.

common_skills.name: Vitality Seed
common_skills.description:
Applies Vitality Seeds to up to 5 nearby allies, healing for [Healing Rate: 80%] HP and applying 1 stack of [Recovery]. Vitality Seeds increase Cast Speed by 40% and Attack Speed by 25% for 6s.

[Recovery]:
Restores HP every second for 12s, stacking up to 3 times.
HP recovery at 1 | 2 | 3 stacks: [Healing Rate: 10%] | [Healing Rate: 15%] | [Healing Rate: 20%]

common_skills.name: Freshness
common_skills.description:
Cleanses all Hard Control (Stun, Fear, Freeze, Knockup, Petrify, Sleep), Silence, and 2 DoT effects on the caster and up to 20 nearby allies. Also heals for [Healing Rate: 60%] HP, applies 1 stack of [Recovery], and prevents the next 3 Hard Control or Silence effects. The effect lasts 4s.

Can be used while skills are disabled.

[Recovery]:
Restores HP every second for 12s, stacking up to 3 times.
HP recovery at 1 | 2 | 3 stacks [Healing Rate: 10%] | [Healing Rate: 15%] | [Healing Rate: 20%]

common_skills.name: Regenerate
common_skills.description:
Releases restorative energy at the target location, healing allies. Healing amount increases based on target's [Recovery] stacks.

[Recovery]:
Stacks: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
Recovers HP: [Healing Rate: 75%] | [Healing Rate: 95%] | [Healing Rate: 115%] | [Healing Rate: 135%]

passive_skill.name: Natural Armor
passive_skill.description: Gains 1 stack of Natural Armor every 5s, stacking up to 4 times. Each stack increases Damage Resistance by 8%. 1 stack is lost for each instance of damage taken.

basic_attacks.name: Leap Strike
basic_attacks.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical Damage to the target. Can cast [Leap Strike] every 5s.

[Leap Strike]:
Charges toward the enemy target, dealing [Damage Rate: 170%] Physical Damage and increasing Attack Speed by 20% for 4s

basic_attacks.name: Javelin Throw
basic_attacks.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 80%] Physical Damage to the target. Performs a [Surging Throw] after 5 Basic Attacks.

[Surging Throw]:
Deals [Damage Rate: 180%] Physical Damage and increases Movement Speed by 20% for 2s

basic_attacks.name: Sweeping Strike
basic_attacks.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 100%] Physical Damage to the target. Can cast [Sweeping Strike] every 5s.

[Sweeping Strike]:
Deals [Damage Rate: 240%] Physical Damage to enemies in range. Gains 6% Damage Resistance for every enemy hit, lasting 4s. Stacks up to 5 times.

common_skills.name: Lance Thrust
common_skills.description: Repeatedly thrusts at enemies in a frontal cone, dealing [Damage Rate: 60%] Physical Damage per hit, then slashes forward to deal [Damage Rate: 130%] Physical Damage to enemies in range.

common_skills.name: Lance Impale
common_skills.description:
Throws a lance at the target location, dealing [Damage Rate: 160%] Physical Damage and reducing Movement Speed by 25% for 3s to enemies in range.

The lance remains at the target location for 6s. Moving to its location allows retrieval, granting 20% Movement Speed and 20% Attack Speed for 4s. Gains 1 charge every 12s, up to 2 charges

common_skills.name: Warding Flourish
common_skills.description:
Channels for 4s, gaining Control Immunity and 60% Damage Resistance. While channeling, reflects 80% Physical Damage back to attackers when taking damage. Deals [Damage Rate: 40%] Physical Damage to nearby enemies every 0.5s.

Recast again while channeling to charge forward, dealing [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage to enemies hit and reducing their Armor by 20% for 4s.

common_skills.name: Skyward Lance
common_skills.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage to enemies in front and inflicts Knockup for 1s.

Can be recast within 6s to slam down, dealing [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage to enemies in range and reducing their Movement Speed by 45% for 3s

common_skills.name: Lance Recall
common_skills.description:
Instantly removes Control effects, deals [Damage Rate: 280%] Physical Damage to enemies in front, and leaps back 8m. Increases Movement Speed by 30% for 4s.

Can be used while skills are disabled

passive_skill.name: Spear Scar
passive_skill.description:
Using a weapon skill grants [Spear Scar].

[Spear Scar]:
The next 4 Basic Attacks gain +60% Attack Speed, +2.5m range, and +30% Lifesteal. This effect lasts 6s. Also has a 35% chance to grant [Target-based Max HP 15%] Shield for 2s.

basic_attacks.name: Sword Slash
basic_attacks.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 130%] Physical Damage to enemy target. Can cast [Sword Slash] every 6s.

[Sword Slash]:
Charges toward an enemy target to deal [Damage Rate: 180%] Physical Damage and inflict 40% Slow for 2s.

basic_attacks.name: Sword Cleave
basic_attacks.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 130%] Physical Damage to enemy target. Can cast [Sword Cleave] every 5.

[Sword Cleave]:
Deals [Damage Rate: 220%] Physical Damage to surrounding enemies. Grants [Target-based Max HP 3%] Shield for each enemy hit, lasting 4s. Stacks up to 5 times.

basic_attacks.name: Sword Energy
basic_attacks.description:
Deals [Damage Rate: 130%] Physical Damage to enemy target. Can cast [Sword Energy] every 6s.

[Sword Energy]:
Unleashes sword energy forward, dealing [Damage Rate: 140%] Physical Damage to enemies hit. Increases Movement Speed by 25% for 2s if at least 1 enemy is hit.

common_skills.name: Vacuum Slash
common_skills.description: Performs 4 forward slashes, each dealing [Damage Rate: 60%] Physical Damage to players ([Damage Rate: 90%] Physical Damage to mobs). The final hit unleashes sword energy forward, dealing [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage to all enemies hit.

common_skills.name: Crippling Strike
common_skills.description: Leaps to the target location, dealing [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical Damage and inflicting 50% Slow for 3s to nearby enemies upon landing. Gains [Target-based Max HP 20%] Shield for 4s when hitting at least 1 enemy

common_skills.name: Power Slash
common_skills.description: Hold to charge with control immunity and gain +20% Damage Resistance. While charging: Deals [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage and Stuns enemies for 0.5s. After charging for 1.5s, deals [Damage Rate: 200%] Physical Damage, Stuns fpr 1.5s and creates a ground wave that deals [Damage Rate: 150%] Physical Damage and inflicts 40% Slow for 4s.

common_skills.name: Defensive Slash
common_skills.description: Begins Blocking for 3s. While Blocking, reduces Movement Speed but gains control immunity and +70% Damage Resistance. Afterward, deals [Damage Rate: 320%] Physical Damage to nearby enemies and reduces their Armor by 20% for 4s. Block can be canceled early

common_skills.name: Heart of Steel
common_skills.description:
Immediately removes all control effects, gains 1 stack of [Sword Momentum], increases Damage Resistance by 25%, and the Attack Speed of the next 3 Basic Attacks by 80% for 8s.

Can be used while skills are disabled.

passive_skill.name: Aura and Blade
passive_skill.description:
Gains 1 stack of [Momentum] every second while in combat and 2 stacks when dealing damage with Basic Attacks, 4 stacks on Critical Hit, 1 stack when taking Basic Attack Damage, and 2 stacks when taking Skill Damage. At 10 [Momentum] stacks, increases Sword Momentum by 1 level. Momentum lasts 20s.

[Sword Momentum]:
Each level grants +3% Damage, +4% Attack Speed, and +4% Damage Resistance. Lasts 8s. Grants up to 6 stacks, decaying over time.
